items.title: Discover BOT VFX's hybrid AI VFX pipeline for Young Washington
items.excerpt: BOT VFX delivered 300 shots in 17 weeks for Young Washington, mixing generative AI (FLUX.2 Klein, Wan) with a Maya/Nuke pipeline: AI crowd extensions, muzzle flashes and near-fully generated town shots. Temporal inconsistency, 4K upscaling and bit-depth limits meant heavy cleanup.
items.note: Breakdown video on Vimeo 1236102167; CG Channel has no og:image

items.title: Ahmad Alameldeen Talks 'Safe Zone,' AI, and Starving Victims of War
items.excerpt: The Oscar-qualified animated short 'Safe Zone' pairs hand-drawn graphite and Procreate frames with motion generated in Kling. The director says AI tools struggled most with human emotion, especially a child in distress.

items.title: Maxon Plus Brings Opt-In AI to Cinema 4D and ZBrush
items.excerpt: Maxon Plus, sold separately from Maxon One, generates base models, textures and sculpting meshes and adds browser-based 3D review. CEO David McGavran explains why generative AI stays out of the main subscriptions.

items.title: Screenweaver adds AI-powered production platform to script editor
items.excerpt: Screenweaver's beta production platform turns an ingested script into an editable storyboard (frame, angle, movement, duration), generates AI scenes from it using Seedance, and exports to DaVinci Resolve or Premiere Pro. It plans AI audio and human-vs-AI provenance tracking.

items.title: Doc filmmakers talk using AI as European plans for creating 'transparent' AI tools revealed
items.excerpt: At IDFA, the first edition to require AI-use disclosure in applications, Brazilian documentary makers describe using AI to 'fabulate' their film's revolutionary climax from archive photos without an on-screen disclaimer. European plans for transparent AI tools were also presented.
items.note: IDFA disclosure rule itself covered 11-19; new angle is filmmaker practice + EU transparent-tools plan

items.title: AI Films From Kerala to the Andaman Islands Set for WIF India x Google Flow Filmathon, Screen at IFFI Goa
items.excerpt: Five films made with Google Flow were picked from 850+ registrations for WIF India's first AI Filmathon and screen at IFFI Goa.
items.note: festival AI winners angle (results, not a call)

items.title: 생성형 AI로 구현한 2050년 디스토피아…영화 '라파엘' 개봉
items.excerpt: Mateo AI Studio and MBC C&I's all-generative-AI feature 'Raphael' opens Nov. 25. The crew spent 1 year 2 months using AI and image-editing tools to keep imagery consistent, and the film was shown at Kling AI's Cannes market conference.
items.note: Opening-day notice; no pre-sales/screen-count numbers in body. Reviews are saturated

items.title: 수백 명 대신 10명…AI가 재편하는 영화산업의 셈법 [AI가 바꾸는 콘텐츠 산업①]
items.excerpt: Raphael's director-producer says the AI feature was made with about 10 people versus the hundreds of crew live-action would need, roughly a tenth of the workforce. The piece looks at how AI changes film production economics.

items.excerpt: Rian Johnson, a vocal critic of AI, warns against demonizing it outright. He also discusses his Warner Bros. deal and new sci-fi thriller.

items.title: David Fincher is being dragged for suspected use of AI in his latest film
items.excerpt: After critics' screenings, viewers accused 'The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth' of 'blatant' gen-AI shots, though some think it is just bad CGI. Netflix has neither confirmed nor denied AI use.
items.note: Cliff Booth angle: NO new studio/vendor statement - only take if curator lacks picks (Fincher defense carded 11-22)

items.title: 구글, 월드모델 '지니 4' API 공개…720p 가상세계 실시간 생성하고 자연어로 조작
items.excerpt: Google opened an API for its Genie 4 world model, which generates 720p virtual worlds in real time that users can explore and edit with natural language. Relevant to AI set and previs generation.
items.note: film angle indirect; check design/gadgets sections for cross-section dup

items.title: ByteDance opens Seedance 2.5's 4K video generation API to developers
items.excerpt: Volcano Engine, ByteDance's cloud unit, opened API access to the 4K version of its Seedance 2.5 video generation model, widening a release that had been limited.
items.note: Seedance 2.5 Flash carded earlier; 4K API is a distinct release. Oldest item (7.6 days)

items.title: Netflix AI clause divides Germany's dubbing industry over voice training rights
items.excerpt: An AI-training clause in Netflix's German dubbing contracts has split the industry: some voice actors refuse to sign, so familiar star voices are being replaced. Slator reports Netflix has raised dubbing pay while the AI dispute remains.
